questions.q: What actually happened to "The DAO" in 2016?
options: An attacker exploited a code flaw and drained about 3.6 million ETH (~$60 million at the time)
It successfully returned all profits to token holders with no issues
It was the first proof-of-stake blockchain
It was voluntarily shut down by its founders
questions.explain: The DAO had raised 150 million worth of Ether from over 11,000 investors before an attacker exploited a flaw in its code, draining roughly 3.6 million ETH.

questions.q: What is the real, concrete difference between Ethereum and Ethereum Classic?
options: Ethereum Classic is a newer, faster version of Ethereum
Ethereum Classic uses proof of stake while Ethereum uses proof of work
Ethereum is the hard-forked chain with the DAO hack reverted; Ethereum Classic kept the original, unaltered history
They are the exact same blockchain with two different names
questions.explain: The hard fork reverted the chain to before the attack and restored funds — that became Ethereum. Ethereum Classic kept the original chain's history exactly as it happened, hack included.

questions.q: According to the blockchain trilemma named in this lesson, what three properties can't all be fully maximized at once?
options: APIs, GUIs, and EIPs
Speed, price, and marketing
Security, decentralization, and scalability
Gas fees, block size, and mining difficulty
questions.explain: Vitalik Buterin's blockchain trilemma holds that a network typically has to compromise one of security, decentralization, or scalability to optimize for the other two.

Ethereum and Bitcoin into a single blockchain
Ethereum and Ethereum Classic back into one chain
Ethereum's existing execution layer with its new proof-of-stake Beacon Chain consensus layer
questions.explain: The Merge, implemented via the Paris upgrade on September 15, 2022, joined Ethereum's original execution layer with the proof-of-stake Beacon Chain that had been running in parallel.

questions.q: What real 2024 development let traditional investors gain exposure to Ethereum's price without holding it directly?
options: Ethereum's original 2014 ICO
The Ice Age difficulty bomb
The Homestead upgrade
The launch of Ethereum ETFs
questions.explain: Ethereum ETFs launched in July 2024, providing a regulated investment vehicle for gaining exposure to Ethereum's price without directly owning the cryptocurrency.
